title: Durable revision-bound worker context
outcomes: A fresh worker receives complete current task context and refuses stale state before writing.

in: Unique run/phase/attempt snapshots, code/state hashes, feedback references and bounded adapter environments
out: Active-task ownership/resume state machine and release publisher
boundaries: Canonical .go snapshots and the registered workspace/native adapter process

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: Write immutable snapshot and feedback before dispatch; no attempt artifact overwrites.
Canonical task and workspace identity, Git revision/index/workdiff and referenced evidence are verified before writing.
New opt-in context uses file references; legacy adapters keep their existing environment shape.
Use explicitly referenced repo-local skills/context; notepad prose cannot replace structured evidence.

quality_attributes.scenario: Changed task/code/index/untracked content or evidence before launch
Fresh repair worker after failed verification or critic

quality_attributes.measure: Full context copies in opted-in environment

risks: A verified prelaunch snapshot detects drift; process isolation and active resume belong to separate contracts.
